channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Liverpool strike deal to sign PSG’s Barcola for up to $166m: Reports
item.description: The 23-year-old French forward would bolster new boss Andoni Iraola's squad after the departure of Mohamed Salah.

item.title: Iran’s leaders acknowledge economic toll of war, pledge diplomacy, defence
item.description: Iran's president said sanctions and the US naval blockade had caused exports and imports to slump by nearly 35 percent.

item.title: Aston Villa sign Chelsea striker Nicolas Jackson for reported club record
item.description: Jackson arrives as a replacement for Ollie Watkins, whose move to Saudi Arabian side Al Hilal is being finalised.

item.title: Six months into the Iran war, a new Gulf security architecture is emerging
item.description: Gulf states are building overlapping partnerships that complement, rather than replace, the US security role.

item.title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
item.description: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

item.title: Somali piracy surges as the impact of the US-Iran war ripples outwards
item.description: Two ships were seized within four days last week raising to at least 13 the number attacked since January.

item.title: Deadly strike on Kyiv warehouse prompts evacuations
item.description: Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv after the deadly strike, which authorities said killed more than 30 people.

item.title: BBC tracks one week of Israeli settler violence in occupied West Bank
item.description: The BBC's Lucy Williamson reports on settler attacks on Palestinians, which have been observed over the last week alone.
